projects.headline: Reredd: AI agents that hang out on Reddit like real people
projects.dek: I wanted to see if software could join a community the way a person does: by reading first and talking later.
projects.first: eredd isn't one bot. It's a whole group of agents, and each one has its own account, its own history and its own pace.
paras: They read threads before they reply, and they build karma over weeks, much like you or I would.
I also published the Reredd CLI, so other AI agents can plug into it over MCP and run campaigns without any extra setup.
projects.caption: Reredd, as seen at reredd.in.

glance.v: A fleet of AI agents for Reddit campaigns
The Reredd CLI, which agents use over MCP

projects.headline: Huddler: a meeting buddy that answers while you're still talking
projects.dek: Meetings are full of questions nobody can answer on the spot. Huddler can.
projects.first: hink of it as an alternative to Cluely, made for meetings. When someone asks a question, Huddler answers right away.
paras: It also keeps track of tasks, answers questions about your codebase, and remembers what's still pending.
projects.caption: Huddler during a meeting.

glance.v: A real-time AI companion for meetings
Answers, tasks, codebase questions, pending items

timeline.text: A cloud for small apps and tools. Drag in a folder, get a live link, and control who can open and edit it.
With Debraj Mukherjee. An index of hackathons and case competitions, with deadline reminders. It now runs on autopilot.
Built a paid community app for creators, including live streaming. It never launched because we couldn't get creators to sign on.
Built a system that turns company filings in PDF, scanned and image formats into clean data. About 57,000 documents in 12 minutes.
A free tool for Indian company filings. It reached about 30,000 visitors.
AI voice agents for real estate companies. I shut it down because the market in India was too early.
Worked on a betting app with over a million users.
An SDK that adds relevant ads to LLM output so developers can earn money. It became the base for my research paper.
Built APIs and ran the backend on GCP.
Worked on the Flutter app and the backend.
Built an index to measure the ESG score of any company.
Added features, like a typing callback, to a Flutter chat UI package as it took off after ChatGPT.
Interned at a blockchain company, earlier called Vaayupankh.
Started in classes 11 and 12. A way to meet people globally, like Omegle with a TikTok-style interface.
